messages:
ana (PM): Quick sync re: v1->v2 compatibility. Need decision on cutover approach and launch gates. Summary below — please react with ✅/👎. Customers asking for no-break tool-calling migrations.

kevin (eng): Proposal: soft-default new accounts to v2; existing accounts stay pinned to v1 unless they opt-in. Rollout: route-level feature flag + traffic split. Canary 5-10%.

mira (eng-runtime): Runtime note: v2 changes token header and function-calling output shape. We'll provide a compatibility shim that maps fields; shim adds ~1.2ms median overhead. We'll quantify with perf tests.

sam (prod-design): Migration guide must include concrete examples for function-calling, structured output schema changes, and an SDK `pinToV1()` snippet.

leo (sales): For enterprise customers, 60-day deprecation is ok if we provide migration tooling and a migration runbook. Need comms plan.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: 1954380000 — will provision v2 aliases and feature-flag gate. Oncall notified.

ana (PM): Launch criteria (draft):
- docs: migration guide + SDK snippets
- tooling: compat shim + conversion util
- perf: <+5% latency overhead at p95
- evals: no quality regressions on core prompt sets
- canary: healthy at 10% for 48h
- rollback: automatic failover to v1 route
- comms: deprecation notice and dashboard banner
Anything missing?

kevin (eng): Add: e2e tests for function-calling edge cases (nested tool responses, streaming partials). Also load-tests for batching behavior.

mira (eng-runtime): Embeddings: ensure vector dims & normalization preserved. If v2 changes default norm, ship a conversion util `normalizeV2(vec)`.

sam (prod-design): Structured output: propose `X-Redwood-Schema: v2` header. Shim accepts v1 shapes and emits that header for v2 responses.

ana (PM): Decision options:
A) Aggressive cutover: force migrate all accounts after 30d
B) Gradual default: new accounts on v2; old accounts pinned unless opt-in (recommended)
C) Keep v1 indefinitely, no new features
Please vote / react. @kevin @mira @leo

kevin (eng): Vote: B :+1:

mira (eng-runtime): Vote: B :+1:

leo (sales): Vote: B :+1: — matches customer asks

sam (prod-design): Action items:
- @kevin: run perf + e2e tests
- @mira: implement compat shim + conversion util
- @docs: draft migration guide and quickstart snippets
- @comms: draft banner + deprecation email
- @sales: notify top-10 customers and offer migration sessions
I'll own rollout timeline doc.

ana (PM): Great. I'll write the decision memo and add to roadmap. Tentative deprecation window for v1-incompatible features: 90 days after migration tooling + docs are published. I'll sync with legal on compliance language. Thanks all :tada:

```
# rollout plan snippet
route: /v1/chat -> /v2/chat
canary: 10%
fallback: v1-compat-shim
monitoring: p95 latency, error-rate, quality-regressions
```
